decisions.reason: The protection cap builds directly on existing accessory and coupling know-how, allowing the firm to interpret feedback and improve it.
Box car trailers are core to the firm's existing passenger car trailer expertise, enabling strong learning and retention.
Car transporter trailers extend the firm's trailer capabilities but require some heavier-duty knowledge, slightly raising drop risk.
Low-bed trailers are less aligned with the firm's passenger-car-focused trailer knowledge, so drop risk is moderate but still manageable.
High trailer covers leverage the firm's accessory and trailer knowledge, supporting ongoing learning and improvement.
As another box car trailer series, it benefits from the same core knowledge; the firm can learn from both and keep them.
